# ROMA: THE REPUBLIC — PREMIUM WORLD & GAMEPLAY REBUILD 08

**Existing canonical project:** GAME LAB / ROMA · current online game at https://game-lab-01-li4fpi.v2.appdeploy.ai/roma-alpha07.html

**Status:** Alpha 08 is a new *source and asset integration candidate*, **not a new live deployment**. Existing GAME LAB routes and browser saves have not been touched in this run because AppDeploy has exhausted its daily deployment allowance (next available 2026-10-17T00:00Z). Do not describe these new assets as live, or this code as visually inspected running on iPhone.

## Actual work shipped in this package

- 11 redesigned, original colour-coded Roman GLB buildings, 290,580 bytes combined: roof tiles, masonry, columns, portico details, farm planting, market goods, gate stonework, barracks, watchtower, decorative ballista. Geometry and asset SHA-256 documented for every asset. Single draw mesh each; model art still stylised, not premium textured/rigged.
- 400×360 large-world code retained, improved continuous terrain ridges with settlement-height preservation, Mediterranean lighting and atmosphere; 3 newly instanced botanical/geological detail systems (scrub, stones, dry grass) complement existing olive and cypress meshes.
- More differentiated Roman infantry/cavalry visual equipment including smaller bucklers for Velites, longer Triarii/Equites thrusting spears, gladius for Principes, helmets, armour and clothing variations. Basic procedural march/engagement movement; **not** skeletal animations.
- More contextual UX with objective hidden in More instead of a permanent mission icon, and high-contrast but unboxed resources. Building confirmation remains contextual. 400×360 map, Roman selections and battle controls retained.
- Rival AI periodically contests frontier capture points and uses siege engines to approach actual Roman defenses. AI execution throttle and save version are included.
- Refactored, isolated ROMA gameplay source architecture retained from Alpha 06. Separate ROMA assets and unchanged baseline files in staged package. Original GAME LAB source integration still requires strict test before merge.

## Verify locally (no purchase or tokens)

```sh
cd roma_sprint08_build
npm test                               # 46 isolated node tests
python tests/assets.test.py            # 11 GLB geometry + SHA-256 checks
python tests/installer.test.py         # artificial original-source fixture + syntax checks
python tests/staging.test.py           # additive Alpha08 staging and no-change safeguards
for f in src/rome/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done
```

## Integration gate — safe additive Alpha08 staging (DO NOT run against production directly)

1. Export an exact copy of current GAME LAB source. Preserve AppDeploy's version history.
2. On a **disposable checkout**, dry-run:
   `python scripts/stage_alpha08.py --project /path/to/gamelab --dry-run`
3. Stage with `python scripts/stage_alpha08.py --project /path/to/gamelab`. The staging tool adds `roma-alpha08.html`, adds its own temporary ROMA-specific engine copy in `src/roma08/`, adds verified GLBs and updates the Vite entry; it deliberately does **not** modify existing `src/rts/`, `src/rome/`, `rts.html`, `roma.html`, Alpha06 or Alpha07. This isolated source copy is a **temporary release-testing compatibility layer**, not a new project or long-term engine fork.
4. Run `npm ci && npm run build` and both existing GAME LAB and added ROMA tests. Inspect unknown deployment differences and abort on failure.
5. Deploy only the resulting new Alpha 08 route. Test the actual game (not GAME LAB hub): GLB loading, mobile touch, building, fighting, navigation, wall drag, strategic zoom, AI, save/resume, portrait/landscape.
6. Demand a documented physical iPhone test and measure frame time and graphics memory before public promotion or consolidation into shared RTS classes.

**Status of this gate:** local synthetic source staging has passed and is strictly additive. Full Vite build and interactive testing against AppDeploy's exact source have **not** been run; publication remains blocked by its deployment quota.

## Rights and unresolved work

See `docs/ASSET_RIGHTS_ALPHA08.md` and `docs/RED_TEAM_PREMIUM_08.md`. No 0 A.D. files, code or music have been copied. Kenney Castle Kit (existing baseline) is CC0. Alpha 08 is **not** yet Total War-level animation/combat, or a shipped new premium mobile title.

**Design principle:** BUILD A WORLD, NOT A CONTROL PANEL.

# ROMA Alpha 08 asset provenance / rights control

**Bundled and transformed (eleven assets)**: All GLBs under `public/rome/assets/` were authored earlier from primitive trimesh geometry within ROMA and extended in this sprint by `tools/premium_asset_pass.py`. No images, rigs, textures, 3D meshes, code or audio from a third-party game were incorporated in the Alpha 08 models. Each file has a SHA-256 entry in `public/rome/ASSETBANK.json`. Asset authorship and entity ownership should still be documented in the canonical GAME LAB IP chain before monetisation; an origin log alone is not legal title confirmation.

**Existing unrelated game baseline:** Kenney Castle Kit CC0 1.0, official source https://kenney.nl/assets/castle-kit ; original per-file licence kept under `public/rts/licences/` of the existing GAME LAB checkout. There is no claim that Kenney is exclusive, Roman Republican or newly integrated.

**0 A.D. (Wildfire Games)**: Official licences at https://play0ad.com/ and https://github.com/0ad/0ad/blob/master/LICENSE.txt. Art and sound CC BY-SA 3.0; game/engine source typically GPLv2 or later with exceptions by directory. Do **not** assume all files share one licence. Commercial use of art may be permitted under attribution and share-alike conditions. Conversion of animated models and an art-only distribution/crediting pipeline is still needed. **0 A.D. content in this Alpha 08 bundle: NONE.**

**3DAssets.dev Roman packs**: Listed as candidate in past exploration, but file-specific CC0 origin/rights and suitability weren't validated in this session, so **none imported**.

**Synty POLYGON Ancient Empire**: proprietary paid third-party pack, explicitly **excluded**.

Preserve source files, author records, attribution, licence texts, checksums, and the ability to redistribute required share-alike derivatives if bringing 0 A.D. art into a future release.

# ROMA — Asset rights & production suitability audit (Sprint 05)

## Proven, physically packaged

Eleven self-authored 3D GLBs are included, generated from Python trimesh geometric primitives; SHA-256 hashes are recorded in `public/rome/ASSETBANK.json`. No third-party meshes, textures, armatures or reference audio are embedded in those eleven files. These are **PROJECT ORIGINAL** files, *not* automatically CC0 by legal assumption. The game project's rights holder controls rights to the original work.

| Building type | Actual GLB | Distinct purpose | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Town / castrum | roman_forum.glb | Administrative town centre | Integrated by RomanView |
| Barracks | roman_barracks.glb | Recruit maniples | Integrated by RomanView |
| House | roman_domus.glb | Population capacity | Integrated by RomanView |
| Market | roman_macellum.glb | Trade | Integrated by RomanView |
| Farm | roman_farm.glb | Food | Integrated by RomanView |
| Lumber camp | roman_lumber.glb | Timber gathering | NEW distinct asset |
| Mine / quarry | roman_quarry.glb | Stone & iron extraction | NEW distinct asset |
| Workshop | roman_siege_workshop.glb | Siege recruitment | NEW distinct asset |
| Tower | roman_tower.glb | Fortification | Integrated by RomanView |
| Gate | roman_gate.glb | Fort passage | Integrated by RomanView |
| Multi-purpose field camp | roman_tent.glb | Canvas camp asset | Included, reserved for later use |

**Historical accuracy caveat:** these are Roman-inspired procedural architecture, not vetted archaeological reconstructions; some are simplified and mixed-era design cues. Historical quality review remains outstanding.

## External candidates—evaluation only, not shipped

- **0 A.D. / Wildfire Games**, https://github.com/0ad/0ad/blob/master/binaries/data/mods/public/art/LICENSE.txt. Artwork CC BY-SA 3.0, commercially usable with attribution and share-alike terms for source art/adaptations. Engine code GPLv2+ under separate license. Roman Republican meshes/models include DAE with texture/actor dependencies and rig/animation pipelines; **none shipped or converted**. The separate 0 A.D. texture licensing notes must accompany any particular selected files. Before adoption verify original file SHA-256, upstream commit, actor references, all textures, animations, attribution, redistribution and game-art compatibility.
- **Kenney Castle Kit**, https://kenney.nl/assets/castle-kit. Official publisher marks CC0; some models were already in the existing GAME LAB baseline, not redistributed as a new downloaded kit in this patch. Medieval castle style does **not** equal historical Roman Republic styling.
- **Kenney Nature Kit**, https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit. Existing baseline asset, CC0 publisher license to be retained in project licensing.
- **Roman Bathhouse and Palaestra / 3DAssets.dev**, https://3dassets.dev/packs/roman-bathhouse-and-palaestra. Publisher advertises CC0 1.0 and 63 GLB modular architecture assets. Source page checked; **individual files not downloaded or technically validated here**, and not included. High-value potential: columns, arches, paving, porticoes, walls. Bathhouse-specific architectural details are not necessarily appropriate to 216 BCE. Requires chronology/art direction review, file-by-file import and quality QA.
- **Quaternius Ultimate Fantasy RTS**, https://quaternius.com/. Historically considered in the original research, but prior transfer was blocked by quota. **No Quaternius file is shipped or claimed**.

## Asset policy

1. An asset may appear in the live game only with a recorded source, exact model file, SHA-256, author, license version, commercial allowance and any attribution/share-alike terms.
2. Use the existing canonical GAME LAB asset bank as the authoritative ledger. `public/rome/ASSETBANK.json` is a verifiable release manifest and should be imported into the canonical bank when project access permits; it is not a competing master.
3. Keep Open Source software licensing separate from art licensing; no inference that a commercial-use license gives ownership or exclusive rights.
4. Existing art style must stay internally consistent; avoid visually unrelated generic packs just because they are CC0.
5. Packaging validated by hash does **not** mean in-game look, animation, orientation and gameplay interaction were tested on device.
